description: Simple assault with fists during an argument in a market
narrative: A customer got into an argument with a vegetable vendor over prices and punched the vendor in the cheek, causing swelling and localized facial pain without breaking any bones or using any weapon.

description: Severe beating resulting in a fractured arm
narrative: During a heated dispute over parking, the accused beat the complainant with fists and kicked him to the ground, resulting in a compound fracture of his left forearm.

description: Stabbing with a kitchen knife causing simple flesh wound
narrative: A man attacked his neighbour with a small kitchen knife during a quarrel, inflicting a cut on his shoulder that required stitches, but did not fracture any bone or cause permanent disability.

description: Sword attack causing grievous bone fracture and limb injury
narrative: An assailant attacked the shopkeeper with a sharp iron sword, striking his arm and shattering the bone, resulting in permanent impairment.

description: Spontaneous slap upon grave provocation
narrative: A passenger hurled sudden abusive obscenities about a driver's mother, causing the driver to react spontaneously and slap the passenger across the face.

description: Grievous injury inflicted on grave provocation
narrative: Upon being provoked with severe physical insults, the accused shoved the agitator against a stone pillar, unintentionally fracturing his collarbone.

description: Blocking a public footpath
narrative: The accused stood in front of the pedestrian on a public road, physically preventing him from walking down the street towards his workplace.

description: Locking a debtor in a godown
narrative: The factory owner locked a worker inside a store room and padlocked the door from the outside, keeping him detained for 4 hours.

description: Threatening physical assault without injury
narrative: An unruly commuter raised his clenched fist at the bus conductor and shook it menacingly, threatening to beat him up without causing bodily injury.

description: Pushing an on-duty traffic police officer
narrative: When a traffic constable stopped an overspeeding car and asked for documents, the driver shoved the constable violently to escape issuing a challan.

description: Outraging modesty of a woman in an elevator
narrative: The accused cornered a female colleague in an office lift, grabbing her dupatta and making sexually offensive physical gestures against her will.

description: Bicycle stolen from outside a park
narrative: A young boy parked his bicycle near the park fence. When he returned 30 minutes later, someone had dishonestly taken it away without his consent.

description: Laptop taken from inside an apartment
narrative: While the tenant was away at work, the landlord unlocked the flat without permission and took a MacBook laptop claiming the tenant owed unpaid maintenance.

description: Mobile phone snatching on a motorcycle
narrative: Two men on a motorcycle drove past a pedestrian, suddenly and forcibly grabbed her iPhone from her hand, and sped off immediately.

description: Extortion under threat of releasing private photos
narrative: The blackmailer threatened the businessman that he would leak private photos to his family unless he transferred 2 lakh rupees, coercing him into handing over the cash.

description: Armed robbery at knifepoint on a deserted road
narrative: A lone mugger cornered a student on a dark street, held a switchblade knife to his throat, and demanded his wallet and gold chain.

description: Robbery accompanied by physical beating and knife slashing
narrative: A robber demanded the victim's wallet and, when the victim hesitated, slashed the victim's hand with a knife and punched him before fleeing with the money.

description: Armed bank heist by a gang of six individuals
narrative: A gang of six masked men entered a cooperative bank branch brandishing firearms, held the staff at gunpoint, and looted 15 lakh rupees from the cash counter.

description: Unlawful entry into agricultural farmland to intimidate tenant
narrative: The accused unlawfully entered onto the complainant's private agricultural land carrying wooden sticks, shouting threats and refusing to leave.

description: Forcible entry into a residential home
narrative: The accused broke the latch of the complainant's residential house at midnight and entered the living room to threaten and insult the occupants.

description: Pre-July 2024 simple hurt incident governed by IPC
narrative: On 15 January 2024, during a local cricket match, two players fought and one hit the other with his bare hands, causing bruises and swelling.

description: Pre-July 2024 house theft governed primarily by IPC
narrative: On 10 March 2024, a burglar entered a locked residential bungalow through a window and stole gold ornaments worth 50,000 rupees.

description: House trespass coupled with simple theft
narrative: An intruder broke into an occupied family home at night, crept into the master bedroom, and stole a laptop and watch without violence.

description: Extortion accompanied by wrongful confinement
narrative: A gang locked a young trader inside a warehouse room and told him they would not release him until his family paid 50,000 rupees in cash.

description: Robbery in dwelling with grievous hurt caused to homeowner
narrative: A burglar entered a bungalow at night to steal jewellery, but when the owner woke up, the burglar struck him with an iron rod, fracturing his arm, before fleeing with the gold.
